flowchart.description: Visualize processes and decision flows with inline declarations and compact branch syntax.
flowchart.template:
flowchart
ss: true

def {
  Start: "Git Push",      shape: terminal
  Build: "Compile Source"
  Unit:  "Unit Tests"
  Lint:  "Linter"
  Sec:   "Security Scan"
  Gate:  "All Pass?",     shape: d
  Deploy: "Prod Deploy",   shape: p
  Roll:   "Rollback"
  Alert:  "Slack Alert"
}

Start -> Build

Build -> Unit, Lint, Sec

Unit, Lint, Sec -> Gate

Gate ? {
  Yes: Deploy -> Alert
  No:  Roll -failed-> Alert
} -> End: "Pipeline Finished"

sequence.description: Show temporal interactions and synchronized/asynchronous message flows between actors over time.
sequence.template:
sequence
  participant User as U
  participant actor Server as S
  participant Database as DB

  U -> S: Sync call
  S --> U: Reply
  U ->> S: Async fire
  S -->> U: Async reply
  U ->x S: Destroy

  loop Every 5 min
    U -> S: Heartbeat
    S --> U: Pong
  end

  alt Happy path
    S -> DB: Save
  else Error path
    S --> U: 500 Error
  end

  opt If logged in
    U -> S: Get Profile
  end

  note left of U: User is waiting
  note right of S, DB: Both involved

class.description: Model object-oriented class structures using clean, C/C++ style native struct declarations.

usecase.description: Describe system scopes, external boundaries, and user interactions within system blocks.
usecase.template:
useCase
  actor "Customer" as C
  actor "Technician" as T
  external "Bank Server" as S
  system "ATM System" {
    usecase "Withdraw Cash" as UC1
    usecase "Check Balance" as UC2
    usecase "Login" as UC3
  }
  C --> UC1; UC2
  T --> UC3
  include: UC1 --> UC3
  dependency: UC1 --> S

cpm_aoa.template:
cpm

  duration: 10, 5, 8, 3
  predecessor: _, A, A, B;C

pert_aoa.description: Estimate project network schedules with uncertainty metrics via Activity-on-Arrow (AOA) chains.
pert_aoa.template:
pert
type: aoa
activity: 1-2, 2-3, 2-4, 3-5, 4-5
optimistic: 2, 5, 1, 3, 2
likely: 4, 7, 2, 4, 3
pessimistic: 6, 9, 3, 5, 4
